technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions across all RSI/Stoch indicators with bearish stochastic cross and falling momentum despite bullish trend structure—high reversal risk outweighs golden cross confluence.

fundamental.summary: GS shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 69 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for GS; neutral market conditions with mixed congressional activity (2 small sales vs 1 small purchase, all 97+ days old) and absent news data provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (291.36) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and financial sector faces credit stress headwinds despite falling DXY.
